title: Clean and Unclean Animals of the Earth
image_prompt: Panoramic pastoral landscape: herds of clean animals—noble sheep, goats, and cattle with divided hooves chewing cud—grazing peacefully in lush green pastures under golden morning light, symbolizing God's call for Israel to live in sacred distinction and purity.

title: Creatures of Waters and Skies
image_prompt: Crystal-clear mountain stream and open sky: schools of clean fish with gleaming scales and fins darting through sunlit waters, while majestic clean birds soar through open blue skies, illustrating divine order and natural purity.

title: The Dedicated Mother at the Sanctuary
image_prompt: Courtyard entrance of the Tabernacle: a devout Hebrew mother, draped modestly in a flowing full-length linen robe and head veil, lovingly cradling her swaddled newborn baby beside her supportive husband, presenting two white turtledoves in a wicker basket to a kind Levite priest.

title: The Priestly Examination of Health
image_prompt: Open sunlit courtyard outside the camp perimeter: a compassionate, white-robed priest gently inspecting a traveler's brow and hands under bright desert sunlight, exercising careful discernment, health, and spiritual guardianship over the community.

title: The Release of the Living Bird
image_prompt: Sun-drenched desert meadow: a priest kneeling beside an earthen vessel of fresh spring water, red cedarwood, scarlet yarn, and green hyssop, releasing a pure living white bird that takes flight with outspread wings, soaring joyfully into the open blue skies as a symbol of divine cleansing and freedom.

title: Restoration to the Congregation
image_prompt: Joyful return to community: a healed Hebrew man, dressed in freshly washed white linen garments with a grateful smile, stepping through the white linen courtyard gates of the Tabernacle with hands raised in thanksgiving, welcomed warmly by his family.

title: Cleansing with Living Water
image_prompt: Quiet oasis stream: a Hebrew man in modest linen attire washing his hands and arms in clear, bubbling spring water under swaying date palms, stepping onto clean dry ground under bright skies in full ceremonial purity and readiness for holy worship.

title: The High Priest Enters the Most Holy Place
image_prompt: Most Holy Place sanctuary: High Priest Aaron, stripped of his golden regalia and clothed purely in humble, immaculate white linen holy garments, standing reverently before the golden Ark of the Covenant, holding a golden incense censer producing a gentle sweet cloud of fragrant white smoke over the Mercy Seat.

title: The Scapegoat Sent into the Wilderness
image_prompt: Wide dramatic desert vista: a solitary, faithful Hebrew guide leading a live white goat by a woven cord along a high desert ridge path away from the distant encampment, releasing the goat into the peaceful open desert canyon, symbolizing the carrying away of transgressions.

title: The Solemn Day of Atonement
image_prompt: Elevated view of the entire encampment of Israel on Yom Kippur: absolute stillness and sacred peace over thousands of tents, with families standing outside their doorways in quiet prayer and holy contemplation under a clear, reverent twilight sky.

title: The Sanctity of Life
image_prompt: Tabernacle outer court: a reverent Hebrew shepherd bringing a dedicated offering before the bronze altar of the Lord, recognizing God as the divine creator and preserver of all life, with a clean pillar of fragrant white smoke rising peacefully into the blue morning.

title: The Holiness of the Family
image_prompt: Dignified Hebrew family: father, mother, and children, fully and modestly clothed in traditional high-necked linen robes and head coverings, standing hand in hand in loving unity outside their clean tent, looking away in resolute moral purity from distant shadowy ruins.

title: Leaving the Corners of the Field
image_prompt: Golden harvest fields: a generous Hebrew farmer smiling as he leaves the outer edges and ungathered stalks of ripe golden wheat untouched, while poor travelers, widows, and strangers in modest robes glean grain bundles with joyful, grateful smiles.

title: Thou Shalt Love Thy Neighbour as Thyself
image_prompt: Heartwarming village scene: a kind Hebrew man offering a clay cup of cold water and a loaf of freshly baked bread to a weary neighbor seated on a stone bench, sharing warmth, brotherhood, and compassion under the shade of an olive tree.

title: Honor the Elderly and Just Balances
image_prompt: Bustling marketplace: a young Hebrew man respectfully rising to his feet and bowing his head in honor of an approaching white-haired elder leaning on a staff; adjacent merchant using clean, honest bronze scales with accurate balance stones under morning sunlight.

title: Ye Shall Be Holy Unto Me
image_prompt: Sunset over Mount Sinai foothills: Moses standing on a stone terrace with staff in hand, gesturing toward the vast assembly of Israel who lift their hands toward heaven in solemn dedication, consecrated as a holy and chosen people unto God.
